# Welcome to my website!

Hello my name is Sara Giuffre-Coppersmith and I am a dual Undergraduate and Graduate student at Case Western Reserve University obtaining a Neuroscience B.S. with Computer Science and Chemistry minors and a Biomedical and Health Informatics M.S. I am currently an Undergraduate Research Student in the Dawn Taylor Lab at the Cleveland Clinic Lerner Research Institute and I am the Software Engineer for the project Mind Mouse.
